tasks.title: B4 Qualification Closure and B5 Entry Freeze
tasks.minimum_acceptance: Run #624 protected-main 14/14 and PIQB_B4_QUALIFIED are frozen as the only B5 entry authority; B4 tasks are recorded COMPLETE without a closure-only PR.

tasks.title: Production Desktop Shell and Unified Local Transport
tasks.minimum_acceptance: The real PySide6 Desktop composes admitted M1/M3/M4/M6/M7/M8/M9 presentation surfaces through the authenticated loopback backend, with one generic fail-closed transport and no GUI database/domain imports.

tasks.title: P01-P13 Product Navigation and Product Spine
tasks.minimum_acceptance: A deterministic P01-P13 Desktop navigation contract exposes Session/Episode/Stage/Scope/Subject/Time/Release identity and exact-revision product workspaces without mutable-latest or hidden recomputation.

tasks.title: Evidence and Metric Drill-down Composition
tasks.minimum_acceptance: Existing M1/M3 release-bound metric, applicability, evidence and quality-state views are reachable from the production Desktop and preserve exact Release/metric identities.

tasks.title: Master Timeline and Historical Replay Composition
tasks.minimum_acceptance: One presentation-only master timeline coordinates exact historical Release/Stage/replay navigation without changing Stage authority, recomputing products, or using current/latest fallback.

tasks.title: Governed 2D/3D Trajectory, Media, Bookmark and Debrief Presentation
tasks.minimum_acceptance: Desktop exposes a presentation-adapter contract for 2D/3D trajectory and media/bookmark/debrief references, with explicit unsupported/unavailable states, no embedded business authority, and semantic separation for C/W/P/A/J/M, Assessment, P2/P3 and P6.

tasks.title: Cross-capability Desktop Integration Qualification
tasks.minimum_acceptance: Deterministic contract/unit/E2E-style Desktop checks prove P01-P13 navigation, transport confinement, exact-ID semantics, replay/visual separation and absence of GUI DB/domain authority under the unchanged 14-job Hosted CI topology.

tasks.title: Desktop Replay and Visualization Qualification Review
tasks.minimum_acceptance: Candidate reviewer returns PASS/PENDING_PROTECTED_MAIN only at the exact B5 candidate head; protected-main reviewer may return PASS/GO/PIQB_B5_QUALIFIED only after exactly 14 required jobs succeed at the merged main revision.
